facts.text: SY01B is the ZSB-SY01B multichannel syringe pump with an integrated rotary valve
SY01B supports 6, 9 and 12 valve ports
SY01B supports syringe volumes of 25, 50, 125, 500, 1250, 2500 and 5000 uL, all with 6000 position steps
get_position_steps queries GetSyringePosition and returns the reply parameter in encoder steps
get_position_ul converts the step count with the configured syringe volume and max_position_steps
get_position_percent scales the step count by max_position_steps
aspirate converts microliters to steps with max_position_steps / syringe_volume_ul and sends RunInCCW
dispense converts microliters to steps and sends RunInCW
reset_syringe_position sets the default speed, sends ResetSyringePosition and SynchronizeSyringePosition, and zeroes the local step count
force_stop sends ForceStop and then reads the position
set_speed_percent rejects a plunger speed outside 0 to 100 percent
get_speed_percent returns the locally stored value, not a device reading
get_motor_status returns the reply parameter of GetMotorStatus
get_address queries GetAddress and returns the reply parameter
get_rs232_baudrate maps the reply parameter through RS232BaudrateReply, whose codes are 9600, 19200, 38400, 57600 and 115200 bps
get_firmware_version returns the major and minor reply bytes as a float
Runze protocol frames use STX 0xCC and ETX 0xDD
The default communication timeout is 0.5 s and the long timeout used for syringe moves is 60 s
move_absolute_in_percent rejects a target outside 0 to 100 percent
move_valve_to_position sends MoveValveToPort with the requested port

operator_required.name: aspirate
operator_required.reason: the usable volume depends on the syringe fitted to the pump and on the liquid path; the configured syringe volume is a deployment setting, so the site supplies the volume envelope

operator_required.name: dispense
operator_required.reason: the usable volume depends on the syringe fitted to the pump and on the liquid path; the configured syringe volume is a deployment setting, so the site supplies the volume envelope

operator_required.name: select_valve_port
operator_required.reason: the number of ports fitted to the valve is a deployment setting (the model supports 6, 9 or 12 ports), so the site supplies the valid port range

safe_state.description: syringe movement stopped with the native ForceStop command; the valve stays where it is
